name: Senjou no Waltz
source:
A girl loses everything, all in one day. Her village, and even worse—her father...

In their place, she acquires a [b]new power[/b]. When she takes up a sword to protect herself and her loved ones, she discovers that it is [b]"cursed"[/b] and holds immense power.

Having obtained something that could shake the very foundations of the nation, the girl has no choice but to live on the battlefield.

The ultra-nationalistic military academy, [b]Nirvana[/b], becomes her new home. There, young men and women who excel in combat gather to compete and sharpen their skills, regardless of their background.

She meets new people, forges strong bonds, and finds what she thought she'd lost: a place to belong.

This is the story of the girl and the talking cursed sword by her side.

[From [url=http://ifi.games/battlefieldwaltz/world/]official website[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩在一天之内失去了一切：她的村庄，甚至还有更糟糕的——她的父亲……

取而代之的，是她获得了[b]新的力量[/b]。当她拿起剑保护自己和所爱之人时，发现这把剑被[b]“诅咒”[/b]，并且拥有惊人的力量。

得到足以撼动国家根基之物后，女孩别无选择，只能生活在战场上。

极端民族主义的军事学院[b]涅槃[/b]成为她的新家。无论出身如何，擅长战斗的年轻男女都会聚集于此，彼此竞争、磨炼技艺。

她结识了新的人，建立起深厚的羁绊，并找到了原以为已经失去的东西：归属之处。

这是一个女孩与身边那把会说话的诅咒之剑的故事。

[译自[url=http://ifi.games/battlefieldwaltz/world/]官方网站[/url]]
